name: Vin de Savoie

limits: For red and rosé wine, Corbeau, Dousset, Hibou Noir and Mondeuse Grise together: at most 5%
For white wine, Bia, Mondeuse Grise, Petite Sainte-Marie and Pinot Gris together: at most 5%
For red and rosé wine, Gamay, Mondeuse Noire and Pinot Noir together: at least 90%
For white wine, Marsanne and Verdesse together: at most 10%
rules.yield_base: 67 hl/ha for red, 71 for rosé and white, 75 for sparkling rosé

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

blurb.text: A Savoie appellation in the Alps foothills, for red and white wines, mostly white. The whites use Chasselas, Jacquère, Altesse and Chardonnay, and the reds Mondeuse, Gamay and Pinot.
